newsitem.title: FRANCE: 1996 Beaujolais nouveau demand said to be up.
newsitem.headline: 1996 Beaujolais nouveau demand said to be up.

text.p: Demand is up for this year's Beaujolais nouveau, described has having a "refreshing and lively taste" and "red fruit perfume", the UIVB wine growers association said on Friday.

"It's difficult at this stage, to give precise figures, but feedback from forwarders suggests an increase in demand from North America while the Japanese market shows signs of recovery after a slump in shipments last year largely as a result of protests over French nuclear testing in the Pacific," a UIVB official told Reuters.

The fine-tuned logistics operation to ensure the wine reaches consumers worldwide in time for traditional cork-popping day, on the third Thursday in November, was being be set in motion at 22.00 French time (21.00 GMT) Friday evening.
Air France Cargo said it would be shipping around 1,200 tonnes of Beaujolais nouveau this year compared to a total of 870 tonnes in 1995.

Apart from the well-established destinations such as New York, Chicago, Miami and Tokyo, the French state airline will be flying shipments in for the first time to Antigua, Damascus, Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City and Maputo.
"The increase in our volume of shipments is largely due to stronger demand from the U.S and Canada and Japan," an Air France Cargo official told Reuters.
